name: COMP_009
markdown:
## Bottom line
**Suggests Invasive (58%)** · Unreliable input · Defer to expert
Reliability is flagged (0.33) and Benign stays in the 90% set [F6].

## Confidence
| Signal | Value | Reading |
|---|---|---|
| Top probabilities | Invasive 58%, Benign 37% | Close call |
| Conformal set | Benign, Invasive | Cannot separate them |
| Reliability / OOD | 0.33 (flagged) / 0.40 | Input suspect |
| Second-model (MUSK) agreement | No | Top classes differ |
| Similar cases | 2 of 5 Invasive | Mixed neighbors |

## Tissue evidence
- **Tumor infiltrating stroma** (regions 2, 3, 6) · ↑ invasive · Strongest concept-model association; above typical · Validated [F2]
- **Marked nuclear pleomorphism** (regions 2, 6, 11) · ↑ invasive · Above typical; invasive-associated · Validated [F4]
- **Gland / tubule formation** (regions 4, 5, 9) · ↓ invasive · Associated with lower invasive likelihood · Weak
- **Frequent mitotic figures** (regions 2, 6, 10) · ↑ invasive · Score high but failed spot check (0/20) · Unreliable [F3]

## Trust check
- **Heatmap**: Removing the top 3 regions drops the invasive logit 0.54 more than random (CI 0.47–0.60); faithful to the classifier.
- **Concepts**: Concept deletion effect is 0.002 (CI −0.005 to 0.007), includes 0; not shown to reflect the classifier. Mitotic figures (leaned on here) are Unreliable.

## Could be wrong if
- Image artifact drives the scores: reliability is 0.33 and quality-flagged.
- Benign is right: similar Benign case BACH_0029 differs mainly in stromal invasion and pleomorphism.

## Check on the slide
1. **2, 3, 6** — Confirm tumor infiltrating stroma, not reactive or benign stroma.
2. **6, 2, 7** — Highest heatmap contribution; confirm invasive carcinoma versus in situ or benign.
3. **4, 5, 9** — Gland-forming areas pointing away from invasion; check for benign glands.
